description: Pitch shifter with a dry and wet mix, working on a short window of the input

params.text: Shifts the pitch in semitones, -12 to +12
Trims the shift by up to a semitone either way
Sets the length of the window the shifter works on, 0.42ms to 200ms at a 48kHz sample rate
Crossfades between the dry input and the shifted signal

inputs.text: Shifts the pitch by an octave per volt, added to the COARSE and FINE knobs, and the voltage is clamped at 5V either way
Adds to the WINDOW knob, 5V covering the whole range, and the total is held inside the knob's limits
Adds to the MIX knob, 5V covering the whole range, and the total is held between fully dry and fully wet

outputs.text: The shifted signal mixed with the dry input

inputs.2:
±5V · continuous · polyphonic

a negative voltage subtracts from the knob.
